ache.title: Livestream hype: codes today, banners tomorrow
ache.note: Flash news from the 5.0 livestream: new characters, artifact crafting, a more flexible battle pass, Primogem rewards and codes. Livestreams are made to get you excited about the next banners before you’ve checked your budget. The free codes are nice. The hype wrapped around them is the expensive part.
ache.tip: Grab the codes, close the stream, and decide about new characters days later, once the hype cools.
lines: a livestream is an ad that waves at you

videoData.title: 5.0 Livestream Flash News: GENSHIN COULD!! | Genshin Impact

textData.text: Big Updates from Genshin Impact 5.0 Livestream! In this video, I share all the exciting news and updates from the Genshin Impact 5.0 livestream. From new characters with unique traversal abilities to important quality of life improvements like artifact crafting and a more flexible battle pass, there's a lot to cover. I also discuss upcoming events, Primogem rewards, and significant changes like the introduction of World Level 9 and the new Radiance mechanics. Watch to get all the details and codes provided during the livestream!
